sandbox: sandbox.sh: docker run --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --cpus 2 --memory 3g --pids-limit 512 --ulimit fsize=256MiB, user postgres, target dirs mounted read-only, only agents/<id>/scratch writable (also mounted at /app/audit), explicit env allowlist of synthetic test values, in-container timeout 540s, in-container PostgreSQL on 127.0.0.1 only, image fair-shifts-tools:latest (pre-built locally, no dependency fetch)
promotion: promote.py: dir-fd confined O_NOFOLLOW traversal, regular file nlink==1, 1 MiB per file / 4 MiB cumulative, exclusive destination create
prompt_delivery: Hunter/verifier prompts are assembled verbatim from skill files into agents/<id>/prompt.md by assemble.py; the Task prompt instructs the agent to read that file in full first.
process_deviations: Phase 3 verifiers for the 11 wave-1 candidates were launched while the wave-2 hunter (h-worker) and its post-wave/final-clean critics were still pending. Verifiers receive only their own candidate, so this does not change their inputs; any wave-2 candidate gets its own fresh verifier.
Verifiers launched in batches to stay under API rate limits after wave 1 lost 7 hunters to a session limit.

agents_spent.note: includes agents terminated by API session limits and their relaunches
